fees.note: From the campground's sites page (read 2026-10-13), 2027 rates run C$55-75 a night for an RV site, for up to 4 adults, by site type and season: C$55-65 for an Outback site (power and water, any size of rig), C$60-69 for a Raven or a waterfront site, C$62-69 for a Mountain Goat site (small campers), C$62-72 for a deluxe full-hookup site and C$65-75 for a primo waterfront site.  The low season is May 13 to June 10 and September 7 to October 1, the peak June 24 to August 20 and long weekends.  Campspot listed the Outback sites at C$55 for June 8, 2027, with none free; the campground was closed on the October 2026 dates read.
